cve_summary: The AsyncPixelTransfersCompletedQuery::End function in gpu/command_buffer/service/query_manager.cc in Google Chrome, as used in Google Chrome OS before 33.0.1750.152, does not check whether a certain position is within the bounds of a shared-memory segment, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (GPU command-buffer memory corruption) or possibly have unspecified other impact via unknown vectors.
commit_message:
Add bounds validation to AsyncPixelTransfersCompletedQuery::End

BUG=351852
R=jbauman@chromium.org, jorgelo@chromium.org

Review URL: https://codereview.chromium.org/198253002

docstring:
/******************************************************************************  
 * Summary:  
 * Finalizes the asynchronous pixel transfer operation by setting up memory  
 * parameters and notifying the completion manager.  
 *  
 * Parameters:  
 * submit_count (base::subtle::Atomic32): The count of submitted pixel transfers.  
 *  
 * Returns:  
 * bool: Returns true if the operation was successfully added to the pending  
 * transfer queue, false otherwise.  
 *  
 * Logic:  
 * The function retrieves a shared memory buffer and checks its validity. It  
 * then sets up memory parameters for the pixel transfer and creates an  
 * observer for completion notifications. Finally, it requests the  
 * AsyncPixelTransferManager to notify when all previous transfers are done  
 * and adds the operation to the pending transfer queue.  
 ******************************************************************************/
